text: Evidence 2026-08-03 (continued): StructuralFirstLevelScenarioSuite now has one ScenarioResult for S07/S10/S16 and passes 3/3 on JVM and 3/3 on Scala.js. S07 asserts planted simple, interaction, and main effects plus a rank-12 basis omnibus; S10 distinguishes canonical and temporal-derivative coefficients, all-basis omnibus, exact at-time/window and FIR-window functionals, units, and nonlinear peak-latency separation; S16 covers duplicate columns, omitted/empty cells, all-zero modulators, typed non-estimable hypotheses, and estimable row-space sums. The full first-level gate passes after the expansion. Remaining qualified gap: independent R/Nilearn design-oracle comparison is still separate, and rank-deficient scenario evidence does not yet assert a cross-solver fitted-value/residual/projector comparison; keep this bead open.
